enMap.Hôm qua, được Tanaka báo tin, tôi mới bi: Yesterday, when I received the news from Tanaka, I learned that your mother had just passed away suddenly. I was really surprised.
enMap.Nghĩ đến nỗi đau của gia đình bạn, không: Thinking about your family's pain, no words can fully describe it.
enMap.Tôi nhớ về những ngày khi còn học cấp 3,: I remember the days when I was in high school, we often went to my friend's house and her mother made cakes for me.
enMap.Mong bạn giữ vững tinh thần và giữ gìn s: Hope you keep your spirits up and stay healthy.
enMap.Từ tận đáy lòng này, tôi cầu nguyện cho: From the bottom of my heart, I pray that your mother rests in peace soon.
